original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.
Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

Searching below C=40 in the #2017 Eisenstein binary scalar-rectangle or fixed-support block-linear additive pairing model; specify a changed premise instead. This bound does not cover every complex decoder.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: On both pinned orientations of the selected gauge44 local program, identify rank-4 child groups sharing a target frame, retime only intervening scalar L-register additions across those independent calls, and replace groups of four or three by exact block-diagonal rank-16 or rank-12 calls. Recompute the fixed-word zero-charge ceiling; also compose the profile arithmetically with the pinned rank-2/rank-3 screen as a joint relaxation.
scope_change_reason: The card's broad block-climb question is narrowed to one source-bound rank-4 pattern absent from the predecessor rank-1 and strict rank-2/rank-3 screens: fourteen same-target-frame groups containing either four or seven calls. The verifier proves the register-level retiming and block-diagonal identity, but waives the physical block-input/output layout and complete supplier bill. The joint profile is only the arithmetic composition of two zero-charge screens.
bottleneck_link: At fixed paid rank mass, replacing four rank-4 calls by one rank-16 call, or three by one rank-12 call, lowers the recursive moment for every positive saving exponent. Whether that ceiling headroom survives input layout, routing, frames, hosting, precision and dirty restoration is the unresolved mechanism.
stop_rule: Stop construction expansion at this screen. The standalone rank-4 profile gains only 2.02% in the ideal ceiling and misses the card's 5% gate. The arithmetic composition with the earlier rank-2/rank-3 zero-charge profile clears 5%, but supplies no physical interface or total cost. Resume only after a source-bound operand/owner/restoration contract is available for one concrete fused block and a complete bill shows the omitted costs can fit.
evidence: RESULT.json and verify.py pin the selected archive and both orientations, enumerate 22 blocks covering 80 rank-4 calls, preserve rank mass 5,586, symbolically verify the rank-12/rank-16 block-diagonal identities, and check exact rational ceiling brackets. The standalone zero-charge ceiling gain is 2.0187%; the composed zero-charge profile is 6.6289% above the selected-word ceiling. No supplier or new kappa is claimed.

predecessors.relationship: Selected-word direct-sum batching of rank-one climbs; this package changes the child rank to four and retimes only within verified same-target-frame groups.
Strict chronological rank-2/rank-3 block screens; this package's separate rank-4 groups may be composed only as a zero-charge profile relaxation.
Pinned predecessor profile whose independent verifier is rerun by this package before the joint arithmetic screen.

open_questions.question: Can one concrete rank-4 group (for example target frame 431) be emitted as an actual rank-16 child with its left/right operands, output owners, scratch lifetime and arbitrary-dirty restoration fully specified?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The positive ceiling is only useful if constructing and consuming the block-diagonal inputs costs less than the moment saved; unknown interface costs are not zero.
open_questions.first_step: Trace the four exact child recipes and their source/output banks through the selected producer and consumer, write the 16-by-16 block inputs and output map, then price every copy, frame conversion, hosted slot, precision term and restoration operation.
open_questions.blocked_by: The frozen local event trace records child rank, register, source/target frame and scalar references, but not the physical ownership and lifetime contract for a fused block call.
